name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: The Tate brothers are arrested in Miami, U.S. Marshals Service tells AP
changes.summary: The brothers were taken into custody on a sealed warrant, the Marshals Service told the AP. British prosecutors said they were seeking the extradition of the brothers on rape and trafficking charges. (Image credit: Julia Demaree Nikhinson).

changes.title: To trial or not to trial: Veteran vaccine advisers say vaccine clinical trials alone don't tell whole story
changes.summary: Two nationally recognized scientists with decades of experience advising U.S. vaccine policy argue that it is a mistake to exclude well-designed observational studies when determining how well vaccines work year to year.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Rising energy prices in the U.S. reduce states' economic output, but they also prompt investments in more efficient equipment and technologies that partially offset those output losses over time, according to a new study by researchers at Penn State.

changes.title: Trump Gutted Civil Rights Agency, Stifling U.S. Scrutiny of Workplace Bias
changes.summary: A little-known federal office spent decades investigating potential discrimination by government contractors — until it was stopped by the Trump administration.

changes.title: The Evolution of Presidential Travel: Horse Carriages to Air Force One
changes.summary: From horse-drawn presidential coaches to Air Force One, presidents have used various modes of transportation to project an image of America for nearly 250 years.

changes.title: Rhode Island fugitive captured after more than 20 years on the run
changes.summary: One of Rhode Island’s “longest-wanted” fugitives was finally arrested this week after 21 years on the run, according to the U.S.

changes.title: Iran says it is suspending commitments to interim deal with U.S. as they exchange attacks
changes.summary: The widening strikes threatened civilians and services to them, including desalination plants for drinking water, while the global economy again was on alert.

changes.title: Maps show wildfire smoke forecast, air quality alerts in swath of U.S.
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is engulfing large swaths of the Midwest and the U.S. East Coast this week.

changes.title: U.S. military says 2 troops are dead and 1 is missing after Iran attacks a base in Jordan
changes.summary: Since the war began, 16 U.S. service members have now been killed and over 430 wounded.
